full_prompt_en: A square winter landscape photograph places a lone dark figure at the edge of a still lake beneath a gray, snow-filled sky. The far shore curves from the left foreground toward the hazy right distance, its low bank covered in uneven white snow and scattered dark stones. Above it, a dense line of tall conifers rises along the left and center, their trunks and branches weighted by snow. The forest gradually thins and disappears into pale gray mist on the right. A faint amber glow shines from behind the middle trees near the horizon, illuminating some narrow trunks while leaving most of the woodland in blue-black silhouette. The small person stands near the center-left shore, facing the lake or distant fog. Their reflection drops almost directly below into the dark water, giving the tiny figure a clear vertical anchor. The lake fills much of the lower half, mostly black and glassy, with irregular patches of thin ice or submerged texture near the shore. It reflects the snowy bank, tree line, pale sky, and scattered warm glints, though the image is softened by water and slight ripples. Tiny light flecks dot the sky and reflection, suggesting snowflakes or moisture catching light. The palette stays near monochromatic in slate gray, blue-black, and white, with only a restrained orange-pink glow behind the trees. Light is dim and diffuse through cloud and fog, strongest at that low warm opening; nearby objects hold no sharp cast shadows. The overall composition is spacious and hushed, balancing one solitary upright silhouette, a long snowy treeline, and a broad mirror-dark foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形冬日风景照片把一名孤独的深色人物放在静湖边，头顶是灰色、飘雪的天空。远岸从左侧前景弯向右侧朦胧远处，低岸覆盖不平整白雪，散着深色石块。岸上密集高大针叶林沿左侧和中央上升，树干与枝条压着雪。森林向右逐渐稀疏，并消失于浅灰雾中。微弱琥珀光从中部地平线附近的树后透出，照亮部分狭窄树干，树林大部分仍为蓝黑剪影。小小人物站在中左岸边，面对湖或远雾。倒影几乎垂直落入身下暗水，使极小身形成为清楚的竖向锚点。湖面占下半幅大部分，近乎黑色且像玻璃，岸边有不规则薄冰或水下纹理。它映出雪岸、树线、苍白天空和零散暖亮点，但水面与细波令镜像柔化。微小亮屑点在天空和倒影中，像雪花或水汽接光。色彩几乎近单色，以石板灰、蓝黑和白为主，只有树后克制橙粉色微光。光穿过云与雾，昏暗且漫射，在那片低处暖开口最强；近物没有清晰投影。整体构图宽阔寂静，以一个孤立直立剪影、长长雪树林线和大片镜面般深暗前景平衡。
style_prompt_en: A photographic winter treatment works chiefly in slate gray, blue-black, and soft white, allowing only a small warm glow to disturb the near-monochromatic field. A long dark silhouette band separates pale mist above from broad reflective darkness below. Snow outlines uneven edges and thin verticals but leaves many interior details submerged in shadow. Atmospheric haze steadily lowers contrast with distance, while a small near figure or focal mark can remain stark against the light bank. Calm water reflects major shapes as softened, slightly broken doubles, adding quiet symmetry. Illumination is low and diffuse, with a concentrated distant warmth rather than hard local sunlight. Fine bright flecks and subtle surface grain keep the image alive within its restrained palette. The overall effect is hushed, spacious, and contemplative, using reflection and sparse accents to hold a large cold field together.
style_prompt_zh: 冬日摄影处理主要使用石板灰、蓝黑和柔白，只让一小片暖光打断近单色区域。长条深色剪影带隔开上方浅雾与下方宽阔反光暗面。积雪勾出不平边缘和纤细竖形，许多内部细节仍沉在阴影中。空气雾气随距离稳定压低反差，近处小焦点记号仍能在亮岸前保持鲜明。平静水面把主要形状重复为柔化、略破碎的镜像，带来安静对称。照明低而漫射，暖意集中在远方，并非生硬近处日光。细小亮屑与轻微表面颗粒让克制色盘中仍有生命感。整体安静、宽阔而沉思，借倒影与稀疏重点维系大片冷色域。
theme_en: A lone figure beside a dark winter lake with snowy pines and a faint amber glow
theme_zh: 一人独立于冬日暗湖边，雪松林后有微弱琥珀光
name: Winter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
